title: One guiding idea. Multiple stories.
slide_intent: Teach writers to draw local language from a shared idea. Keeping the underlying relationship visible allows the wording to respond to a particular audience.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can vary its expression across programs while retaining the ideas of revealing, achieving and sharing.
demonstration: Three illustration columns sit above segments of a black phrase strip. Associated words cluster beneath each segment, ending in the three working verbs.
practical_value: Select words for a local message by working down the relevant column and checking how the other two ideas fit the story.

content_islands.name: Interpretive prompt
content_islands.spec: Set the explanation and red question in the left column.

content_islands.name: Three-part phrase
content_islands.spec: Align an illustration above each section of the black guiding-idea strip and use rules to separate the columns.

content_islands.name: Associated vocabulary
content_islands.spec: Cluster related words below the strip and give Reveal, Achieve and Share a baseline beneath their respective columns.
